title: feat(components): the edit form names the fields a visible update action would require, before it is pressed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu4iEg7dMGWavC1JjYSAwAZj)_

Fixes #28382

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/i18n` gains the `form.requiredForAction` key in all ten locales; no accept set moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

Branch note: `claude/project-thread-3lhyz5` is the branch the platform assigned to this card thread (claim 6546347620 names it), not the repo's `claude/issue-N-slug` convention.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：编辑记录时，如果某个可见的「update + 静态 patch」动作执行后会让一个空字段变成必填，表单就在该字段下写一行提示，例如 showcase 草稿发票的「Issued On」下显示 “Required to run “Submit for Sign-off”.”。
- **为什么改**：服务端在动作的 patch 合并后的记录上跑 `requiredWhen`，而表单只看当前记录，所以第一次点「Submit for Sign-off」总会被拒（`Issued On is required`），事前没有任何提示。
- **风险与回滚**：纯提示，不拦保存、不改字段的必填状态、不改服务端；只在编辑表单生效，读对象 schema 走已有的数据源缓存。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` 的 `actionOutcomes` 块和 `renderFieldDescription` 调用处；`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/actionRequirements.ts`（哪些动作计入）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-required-for-action-28382.test.tsx`，预期 12 条全过；或在 showcase 打开一张 draft 发票点 Edit，Issued On 下出现该提示。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Measured on `main` `f91ab5a0` before any code, with the showcase (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`) and the console (`vite`, proxied):

| | On `main` | This PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_invoice/showcase_submit_signoff` on draft INV-1004 (`issued_on` empty) | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, "Issued On is required" | unchanged: the server stays the source of truth |
| Edit Invoice dialog on the same draft | "Issued On" shows nothing | "Issued On" shows "Required to run “Submit for Sign-off”." under the control |

- **`actionRequirements.ts` (new, in the form renderer's directory).** `patchingUpdateActions` keeps a declared action only when its whole write is known before it runs: `operation: 'update'`, a non-empty static `patch`, no `params` (an empty list is fine), and at least one location (a locationless action is placed nowhere, per `actionRendersAt`). `usePatchingUpdateActions` reads the object's actions once per object through the data source the renderer already has (`getObjectSchema`, the read every form host makes and the adapter caches), on edit forms only.
- **`form.tsx`.** `actionOutcomes` is the record each kept action would leave: `{ ...ruleRecord, ...patch }`, the merge the server makes. An action is dropped when it is switched off, when the caller lacks its `requiredPermissions` (the `action:bar` gate), or when its `visible` predicate does not hold over the live record. That predicate fails closed and quietly, because the action's own button reports its fault. In `renderFormField`, a field with a `requiredWhen` that is not required now, is editable and is empty gets one line per action whose record makes it required. The line sits inside the field's `FormDescription`, so the control's `aria-describedby` announces it.
- Nothing about Save changes: the field gets no asterisk and no `aria-required`, and the submit-time required check reads the same live verdict as before.
- **i18n.** `form.requiredForAction` in all ten locales, plus the renderer's provider-less fallback row (byte-identical to `en`).

## Tests

- `form-required-for-action-28382.test.tsx` (new, 12 tests) through the real `form` renderer with a data source in `SchemaRendererContext`: the note on an edit form and its `aria-describedby` delivery; Save still writes with the field empty; the note goes when the field is filled; it gives way to the asterisk when the record as it stands requires the field; a create form reads nothing; an action whose `visible` does not hold, or that collects `params`, adds nothing; two actions give two lines and an unrelated patch none; and `patchingUpdateActions` unit cases.
- Ablation (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored with `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - `actionOutcomes.length > 0 &&` to `< 0`: 5 tests red (every case that expects a note).
  - `visible !== true &&` to `false &&`: 1 red, the `visible` skip case.
  - `!required &&` to `true &&`: 1 red, the asterisk case.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/` + `packages/i18n/` (one run): 177 of 178 files passed; the only red was the German quote census below (2 tests). After moving it, `packages/i18n/` reran: 94/94 files, 1438 passed, 13 skipped.
- Moved pin: `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`. The German value „{{action}}“ is one more matched pair, so its census goes from 103 to 104 (both literals), with the history comment extended.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/components --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: exit 0. eslint on each changed file: 0 errors. `form.tsx` has the same warning count as on `main` (58).

## Acceptance notes

- Heads-up only, as the card asks: Save is never blocked, and the server's refusal stays the source of truth for the action.
- The renderer reads the actions itself, not through a new `FormSchema` key, so every form host (modal, drawer, page, tabbed, wizard) gets the note with no host or `@object-ui/types` change. This is the same pattern the renderer already uses for the record-currency used codes.
- Not covered, by design: an action that collects `params` (the dialog's values are unknown before the press), and any non-declarative action (`api` / `flow` / `script` bodies). The optional "say what is missing on the button" half of the card is not done here: the button lives in the record header, which another card holds.
- Live check: the after screenshot shows the note under "Issued On" on the showcase's Edit Invoice dialog.

## Verification

- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 34 commands; on head `c56ed27d` all 34 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (the full list is in the os-dev-report on the card). `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` and `check:i18n-drift` exit 0.
- No open pull request touches `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/**` or `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/**` at this head.
